newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly up in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed slightly up by 0.19 percent in thin trade after a four-day closer for the Eid al-Adha holiday, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 505.02 points from 504.04 at the previous session on Wednesday.
Total volume was 732,645 dinars against 6.61 million dinars.

Detergents firm SPCD gained one dinar to 38 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia gained 0.96 dinar to 51. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing was up 0.8 dinar to 33 dinars. Coca and beer bottler SFBT rose 0.2 dinar to 92.7 dinars.

Banque Nationale Agricole fell 0.98 dinar to 31.62 dinars. BDET bank slid 0.52 dinar to 16.92. BTEI edged 0.4 dinar lower to 23 dinars. BIAT bank eased 0.3 dinar to 36.7. Airline Tunis Air declined 0.2 dinar to 23 dinars.
